messages:
sofia: Quick preflight — I'm about to create an annotated tag and draft GH release for v0.22.0. Can folks eyeball artifacts + checksums / who will sign the tag? Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/releases/new (draft)

liam: I'll grab the mac/linux binaries and check shasums. ETA 15m.

maya: I'll verify checksums against the CI artifact store and confirm build IDs. Do we need a signed tag? :thinking:

sofia: Yes, signed annotated tag per release policy. Command I use:
```
git tag -a v0.22.0 -m "v0.22.0 — batch perf + tag fixes"
gpg --detach-sign --armor v0.22.0
git push origin v0.22.0 v0.22.0.asc
```

aj: I can handle the signing if you share the signing key passphrase in 1:1. Otherwise I can sign from the release machine. :thumbsup:

release-bot: CI artifacts for build 2026-04-02-3357 uploaded: s3://redwood-artifacts/2026/04/02/3357/ (checksums available)

liam: Verified: sha256 for linux tar.gz = 3f2a7c9d4b5e6a1f2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5 and matches CI. linux+mac ok.

maya: Build ID matches, artifacts intact. I've added a short note in the draft body about the changelog entry and migration steps.

sofia: Awesome. @aj please sign and then I'll create the annotated tag + publish draft release (keeps as draft until binary checksums are attached). If you can't sign, I can do an unsigned tag and we can follow up with a signed release.

aj: Signing now. Pushing tag in ~2m.

aj: Done. Pushed tag and asc. PR for release notes already linked in draft.

sofia: Thanks all. I'll attach the checksums to the draft and schedule the publish for 09:00 UTC tomorrow unless any objection. :calendar:

jordan: No objections from infra. Recommend one last smoke test on staging rollout window.

sofia: Noted — adding staging smoke test to release checklist. Closing the thread, will ping if anything blocks.
